news.headline: DE Danielle Hunter, LB Azeez Al-Shaair among Texans ruled out vs. Browns
news.description: The Texans will be without a number of key starters -- including running back David Montgomery and All-Pro defensive end Danielle Hunter -- when they travel to face the Browns.

news.headline: Sources: Vikings made initial Kirk Cousins trade call to Raiders before MNF

news.headline: Patriots are 6-0 after a regular-season loss under Vrabel: Can they do it again?

news.headline: Despite Cousins trade, are Vikings back to square one at QB?

news.headline: Seahawks are hurting with injuries, but two players will return vs. Raiders
news.description: QB Drew Lock will start again for Darnold. And LB Uchenna Nwosu and WR Rashid Shaheed will return to the field in Las Vegas.

news.headline: Vikings to start reacquired QB Kirk Cousins vs. Packers

news.headline: 49ers OT Williams, LB Greenlaw questionable, WR Evans out vs. Cowboys
news.description: The 49ers are listing left tackle Trent Williams and linebacker Dre Greenlaw as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, while receiver Mike Evans has been ruled out.

news.headline: When will Lamar Jackson return to the field?
news.description: Jamison Hensley provides an update on Jackson's thumb injury post surgery, projecting a potential return as early as Week 16.

news.headline: NFL outlines steps in Jalen Hurts investigation in letter to senator
news.description: The NFL provided some additional details about the investigation into how Jalen Hurts' blood clots were handled in response to an inquiry from a U.S. senator.
